title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 Update (Build 26)
releaseNotes: WhatsApp Fixed: Direct whatsapp:// URI scheme used for reliable message sending
Students Due Card: Changed to deep purple theme (no more pinkish-red)
Members: Floating 'Add Member' FAB removed — use the top-right icon instead
Members Sort: Sort button now opens sheet (Newest, Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Expiring Soon)
Members Filter: Filter button now opens sheet matching all 6 category filters
No Neon Colors: Enforced throughout — all colours are muted, rich, dark variants
